license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice or attempt to offer to practice pharmacy, as defined in this act, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unexpired, unrevoked and unsuspended license issued under this act.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Pharmacy.

name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Pharmacy.

type.quote: the State Board of Pharmacy shall consist of the Commissioner of Professional and Occupational Affairs, the Director of the Bureau of Consumer Protection in the Office of Attorney General, or his designee, two persons representing the public at large, and five persons who are licensed to practice pharmacy in this Commonwealth

age_minimum.quote: Is not less than twenty-one years of age and is a citizen of the United States

moral_character_required.quote: Has satisfied the board that he is of good moral and professional character

degree_required.value: Bachelor of Science or advanced degree in pharmacy
degree_required.quote: Holds a Bachelor of Science or advanced degree in pharmacy granted by a school or college of pharmacy which is accredited by an accrediting body recognized by the board

accrediting_body.value: accrediting body recognized by the board
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by an accrediting body recognized by the board

degree_level.quote: Holds a Bachelor of Science or advanced degree in pharmacy granted by a school or college of pharmacy which is accredited by an accrediting body recognized by the board

school_approval_basis.quote: accredited by an accrediting body recognized by the board

credential_pegged.quote: Holds a Bachelor of Science or advanced degree in pharmacy granted by a school or college of pharmacy which is accredited by an accrediting body recognized by the board

required.quote: Has completed an internship or other equivalent program which has been approved by the board or has demonstrated to the board's satisfaction experience in the practice of pharmacy which meets or exceeds the minimum internship requirements of the board

experience_source.quote: To insure proficiency in the practical aspects of pharmacy, the board shall, by regulation, prescribe internship requirements which must be satisfactorily completed prior to issuance of a pharmacist license.

kind.quote: pharmacy internship experience as required under this act shall be obtained by employment in any licensed pharmacy under the direct supervision of a pharmacist

exams.name: Pharmacy licensure examination
exams.notes: In case of failure at a first examination, the applicant shall have within two years the privilege of a second and third examination. After third failure, additional preparation required.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by a qualified and approved professional testing organization)
exams.quote: Has satisfactorily passed such examinations given by the board.

interval_years.quote: The board shall provide for, regulate and require all individuals licensed as pharmacists or assistant pharmacists to renew their license biennially

required.quote: Effective with 1988 renewals, refuse to renew the license of a pharmacist until the pharmacist submits proof to the board that he has satisfactorily completed an approved program of continuing professional education during the previous licensing period

available.quote: The board may, without examination, license as a pharmacist any individual who, at the time of filing application therefor, is licensed as a pharmacist in any other state, territory or possession of the United States

requirements.value: Applicant must produce evidence of required secondary and professional education and training including internship, be of good character and morals, and the other state must grant reciprocal licensure to PA-licensed pharmacists under similar conditions.
requirements.quote: the said individual shall produce evidence satisfactory to the board of having had the required secondary and professional education and training, including internship, and is possessed of good character and morals as required of applicants for licensure under the provisions of this act

exists.quote: the State Board of Pharmacy shall consist of the Commissioner of Professional and Occupational Affairs, the Director of the Bureau of Consumer Protection in the Office of Attorney General, or his designee, two persons representing the public at large, and five persons who are licensed to practice pharmacy in this Commonwealth

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice or attempt to offer to practice pharmacy, as defined in this act, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unexpired, unrevoked and unsuspended license issued under this act.

credential_type.quote: The State Board of Pharmacy may license as a pharmacist any person who has filed an application therefor

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice or attempt to offer to practice pharmacy, as defined in this act, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unexpired, unrevoked and unsuspended license issued under this act.

title_protection.quote: Any person, firm or corporation to use the title "pharmacist", "assistant pharmacist", "druggist", "apothecary", except a person duly licensed as a pharmacist in Pennsylvania

scope_protection.quote: any person not duly licensed as a pharmacist, pursuant to section 3 hereof, to engage in the practice of pharmacy, including the preparing, compounding, dispensing, selling or distributing at retail to any person any drug

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procured a personal license through fraud, misrepresentation or deceit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procured a personal license through fraud, misrepresentation or deceit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty or pleaded guilty to any offense in connection with the practice of pharmacy or involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been found guilty, pleaded guilty, entered a plea of nolo contendere, or has received probation without verdict, disposition in lieu of trial or an Accelerated Rehabilitative Disposition in the disposition of felony charges, to any offense in connection with the practice of pharmacy or any offense involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit to practice pharmacy because of intemperance in the use of alcoholic beverages, controlled substances or any other substance impairing performance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit to practice pharmacy because of intemperance in the use of alcoholic beverages, controlled substances or any other substance which impairs the intellect and judgment to such an extent as to impair the performance of professional duties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit or unable to practice pharmacy by reason of a physical or mental disease or disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or unable to practice pharmacy by reason of a physical or mental disease or disability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license to practice pharmacy issued by another state suspended or revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license to practice pharmacy issued by any other properly constituted licensing authority of any other state suspended or revoked

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or knowingly permitted the violation of any provision of this act or regulation of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or knowingly permitted the violation of any provision of this act or regulation of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly allowed any unlicensed person to take charge of a pharmacy or engage in compounding, distribution or dispensing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly allowed any unlicensed person to take charge of a pharmacy or engage in the compounding, distribution or dispensing of prescriptions or controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Compounded, dispensed, sold or caused the compounding, dispensing or sale of any drug or device with improper ingredients or quantities without prescriber consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has compounded, dispensed, sold or caused the compounding, dispensing or sale of any drug or device which contains more or less than the proportionate quantity of ingredient or ingredients specified by the person who prescribed such drug or device

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of grossly unprofessional conduct including deception, false advertising, paying rebates, and other enumerated acts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of grossly unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license to practice pharmacy suspended, revoked or refused, or received other disciplinary action by another state, territory or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license to practice pharmacy suspended, revoked or refused, or received other disciplinary action by the proper pharmacist licensing authority of another state, territory or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acted in such a manner as to present an immediate and clear danger to the public health or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has acted in such a manner as to present an immediate and clear danger to the public health or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of incompetence, gross negligence or other malpractice, or failure to conform to standards of acceptable and prevailing pharmacy practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of incompetence, gross negligence or other malpractice, or the departure from, or failure to conform to, the standards of acceptable and prevailing pharmacy practice, in which case actual injury need not be established.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: The State Board of Pharmacy shall issue a permit to any person to conduct a pharmacy who has filed an application therefor

definition_quote.value: the provision of health care services by a pharmacist, which includes the interpretation, evaluation and implementation of medical orders for the provision of pharmacy services or prescription drug orders; the delivery, dispensing or distribution of prescription drugs; participation in drug and device selection; drug administration; drug regimen review; drug therapy management; drug or drug-related research; compounding; proper and safe storage of drugs and devices; management of drug therapy; maintaining proper records; patient counseling; and such acts, services, operations or transactions necessary or incident to the provision of these health care services.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of pharmacy" means the provision of health care services by a pharmacist, which includes the interpretation, evaluation and implementation of medical orders for the provision of pharmacy services or prescription drug orders; the delivery, dispensing or distribution of prescription drugs; participation in drug and device selection; drug administration; drug regimen review; drug therapy management

value: interpretation, evaluation and implementation of medical orders
delivery, dispensing or distribution of prescription drugs
proper and safe storage of drugs and devices
methods_authorized.quote: the interpretation, evaluation and implementation of medical orders for the provision of pharmacy services or prescription drug orders; the delivery, dispensing or distribution of prescription drugs; participation in drug and device selection; drug administration; drug regimen review; drug therapy management, including such services provided under the Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvements, and Modernization Act of 2003; drug or drug-related research; compounding; proper and safe storage of drugs and devices; management of drug therapy pursuant to section 9.3 or, if in an institutional setting, consistent with the institution's assignment of clinical duties pursuant to a written agreement or protocol as set forth in section 9.1; maintaining proper records; patient counseling

drug_authority.value: Pharmacists are authorized to manage drug therapy under written collaborative agreements or protocols with licensed physicians, but nothing in this act shall be construed to provide prescriptive authority to a pharmacist.
drug_authority.quote: Nothing in this act shall be construed to provide prescriptive authority to a pharmacist.

pharmacy_technician_registration_require.quote: An individual must possess an unrestricted registration from the board to practice as a pharmacy technician.

pharmacy_technician_trainee_permit_avail.quote: Upon the submission of a board-approved written application and fee, the board may issue a temporary registration to practice as a pharmacy technician trainee.

technician_to_pharmacist_supervision_mod.quote: a pharmacy technician shall be responsible to and under the direct and immediate personal supervision of a board-licensed pharmacist.

technician_data_entry_without_immediate_.quote: A pharmacy technician may conduct data entry, including prescription entry, drug order or patient information, into a patient profile via technological means without the immediate supervision of a board-licensed pharmacist if all of the following apply

technician_minimum_age.quote: Be at least seventeen years of age and possess a high school diploma or equivalent.

technician_trainee_minimum_age.quote: Be at least sixteen years of age.

collaborative_drug_therapy_management_au.quote: A pharmacist shall enter into a written collaborative agreement with a licensed physician authorizing the management of drug therapy for a disease or for a condition or symptom of a disease before practicing the management of drug therapy in a setting other than an institutional setting.

drug_therapy_management_settings.quote: A pharmacist shall be permitted to enter into a written agreement or protocol with a licensed physician authorizing the management of drug therapy in an institutional setting.

drug_therapy_management_protocol_max_dur.quote: Remain in effect for a period not to exceed two years upon the conclusion of which, or sooner, the parties shall review the agreement and make a determination as to its renewal, necessary modifications or termination.

prescriptive_authority_explicitly_exclud.quote: Nothing in this act shall be construed to provide prescriptive authority to a pharmacist.

professional_liability_insurance_require.quote: A pharmacist who is a party to a collaborative agreement authorizing the management of drug therapy shall obtain and maintain a level of professional liability insurance coverage in the minimum amount of one million dollars ($1,000,000) per occurrence or claims made.

professional_liability_insurance_minimum.quote: obtain and maintain a level of professional liability insurance coverage in the minimum amount of one million dollars ($1,000,000) per occurrence or claims made.

pharmacy_permit_required.quote: No person shall operate or advertise a pharmacy until the person has been granted a pharmacy permit by the board.

pharmacist_in_charge_required.quote: Has insured that a pharmacist duly licensed in Pennsylvania shall be in charge of said pharmacy at all times that the pharmacy is open

nonresident_pharmacy_registration_requir.quote: A nonresident pharmacy shall register on a biennial basis with the board and obtain a certificate of registration to conduct a pharmacy in accordance with this section.

nonresident_pharmacy_toll_free_number_re.quote: A nonresident pharmacy shall, during its regular hours of operation, but not less than six days per week, and for a minimum of forty hours per week, provide a toll-free telephone number to facilitate communication between patients in this Commonwealth and a pharmacist

prescription_record_retention_years.quote: Contains a suitable book or file in which shall be preserved, for a period of not less than two years, every prescription compounded or dispensed therein

emergency_prescription_refill_authorized.quote: "Emergency prescription" means a refill of a prescription which is essential to the continuation of therapy in a chronic condition, for which the refill has not been authorized

emergency_prescription_max_supply_days.quote: the quantity of that refill is in conformity with the prescribed directions for use, but limited to a seventy-two hour emergency supply. If the prescription is not dispensed or sold in a seventy-two hour supply, an amount not to exceed a thirty-day emergency supply may be dispensed or sold.

generic_substitution_authorized.quote: This restrictive clause shall not apply to proper substituting of generically equivalent drugs as stipulated under the act of November 24, 1976 (P.L.1163, No.259), referred to as the Generic Equivalent Drug Law

prescription_transfer_between_pharmacies.quote: Adheres to the following requirements for transferring prescriptions between pharmacies in Pennsylvania

price_disclosure_to_patient_required.quote: For every prescription medication that a consumer intends to purchase, a pharmacist shall, upon request, disclose the following

multiple_state_licensure_reporting_requi.quote: Any licensed pharmacist of this Commonwealth who is also licensed to practice pharmacy in any other state, territory or country shall report this information to the board on the biennial registration application.

impaired_professional_program_available.quote: The board may defer and ultimately dismiss any of the types of corrective action set forth in this act for an impaired professional so long as the professional is progressing satisfactorily in an approved treatment program

mandatory_reporting_of_impaired_pharmaci.quote: Any hospital or health care facility, peer or colleague who has substantial evidence that a professional has an active addictive disease for which the professional is not receiving treatment, is diverting a controlled substance or is mentally or physically incompetent to carry out the duties of his or her license or certificate shall make or cause to be made a report to the board

poison_schedule_maintained_by_board.quote: Poison means and includes the compositions of the following schedules

poison_sale_minimum_age.quote: No poison enumerated in Schedule "A" and "B", or poisons which may hereinafter be added to said schedules, shall be sold, delivered or furnished to any person who is less than sixteen years of age.

poison_sale_recordkeeping_required.quote: No person shall sell, distribute or furnish any poisons included in Schedule "A", or the additions thereto, without making or causing to be made at the time of selling an entry in a poison book kept solely for that purpose, stating the date of sale, the name, address and signature of the purchaser, the name and quantity of the poison sold, the statement of the purchaser of the purpose for which it is required, and the name of the dispenser who shall be a registered pharmacist.
